summary.en: A number changes like an odometer: each digit column rolls a full lap and lands on its new digit, one column after another.
summary.zh: 数字像里程表一样变：每一位各自滚过一整圈再落到新数字上，从左到右一位接一位。

fits: A counted value arriving or changing in place: a KPI, a total, a score that the next line states.
notFor: Numbers that are not quantities (versions, ids, dates); more than one rolling number on screen at once.

intent.en: The value reads as counted, not typed: the wheels carry over like an odometer and the width never jitters, so the eye reads the change.
intent.zh: 数字读起来是数出来的而不是打出来的：每一位像里程表一样进位、宽度不抖，眼睛只看变化。

content.en: One number (old and new value, ≤ 9 digits with separators), an optional label (≤ 24 chars) and note.
content.zh: 一个数字（旧值和新值，≤ 9 位，可带分隔符），可选一个标签（≤ 10 字）和注释。

fits.zh: 一个计数值就地出现或变化：KPI、总数、下一句要说的分数。

notFor.zh: 不是数量的数字（版本号、编号、日期）；同屏不止一个滚动的数字。

pairs.note: the total rolls up once the new point lands

en: One rolling number on screen at a time; two rolls compete for the eye.
Only for quantities: a rolling version number or date reads as a slot machine.
zh: 同屏只滚一个数字，两个一起滚会抢视线。
只给数量用：版本号、日期滚起来像老虎机。

upstream.name: 列表堆叠压弹
upstream.summary: 列表卡从画面底部逐张飞上摞起，每张落地压弹整摞、计数器同步跳一格
upstream.use: feed/雷达/收件箱类"每天有新东西"的镜头；强调持续积累的资产列表

upstream.name: 纸张标题卡
upstream.summary: 一句话逐词压印上纸、一个词标强调色斜体、短划线收束
upstream.use: 章节转场/价值主张字卡；重要功能出场前的引导卡；全片呼吸位
upstream.energy: 低（呼吸位，隔开两段高能镜头）

letters scramble and resolve into a word; digit-roll keeps every digit on its own reel
